observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for an HP LaserJet Pro MFP M28w.
The box is wrapped in clear plastic shrink-wrap.
The actual printer is not visible; only the packaging is shown.
Text on the box confirms 'Wireless | Print | Scan | Copy' capabilities.
The background contains other boxes, including one for a Canon product, suggesting a retail or warehouse setting.
A watermark 'BLESSED STAN PAUL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: No cables are visible in the photo.
The visible text on the box front does not explicitly state monochrome or black and white.

risks.proof: A photo of the actual printer outside of the box.

risks.risk: The printer may have mechanical defects or a high page count.
risks.proof: A photo or video of a printed test page and configuration report.

risks.risk: The toner cartridge may be missing, depleted, or a non-genuine replacement.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual printer out of the box.
A printed test page showing the current page count and toner levels.
Photo of the identification plate on the back of the printer showing the serial number.
Photos of the included power and USB cables.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the retail packaging. Because the actual item is not visible, it is priced at the worst-case scenario (non-functional and used) until proof of condition and contents is provided.
